context_requirements: Functional Hedgehog pathway with SMO expression and GLI-dependent transcription
Presence of SHH ligand or pathway-activating mutations (e.g., PTCH1 loss, SMO mutation, SUFU loss)
Cell lines with low basal Hedgehog activity are expected to show little or no response
falsifiers: No decrease in GLI2 or other Hedgehog target genes at 6 or 24 hours in any cell line
No antiproliferative or gene-expression changes at 24 hours in cell lines with known Hedgehog pathway activation
Strong and consistent upregulation of Hedgehog target genes across all cell lines

changes: Removed GLI2, CCND1, MYC, and BIRC5 from proximal_up: SMO antagonism inhibits GLI-dependent transcription, so these Hedgehog targets should decrease, not increase.
Kept GLI2, CCND1, MYC, BIRC5, JUN, and FOSL1 in proximal_down as genes whose transcription is lowered by SMO inhibition.

No changes to late_up, late_down, generic_effects, kinetics, magnitude, line_response, context_requirements, or falsifiers; these are broadly consistent with a slow-acting, low-magnitude SMO antagonist in mostly Hedgehog-inactive lines.
